title: Movie Data Correlation
shortDescription: Which factors track a film's box-office gross? An exploratory correlation study in Python and Jupyter.
description: An exploratory analysis of a movie dataset in a Jupyter notebook: cleaning the data, then comparing features against gross revenue with correlation matrices, scatter plots and heatmaps. The full notebook is on GitHub.

technicalDetails.approach: Clean the data, then measure and visualize correlations between each feature and gross revenue.
